description_expanded: OverviewSANTA ROSA BEACH – Beach LegaSea Private Pool & Multiple Outdoor Spaces | Steps to Dune Allen Access | Sleeps 16 DESCRIPTION A spacious, multi-level luxury retreat in Santa Rosa Beach with an elevator for easy access. Perfectly designed for large families or groups, this home offers four king bedrooms, a queen bunk room, five full and two half bathrooms, and multiple living spaces spread across three levels. Just a short walk to the Gulf, Stinky’s Fish Camp, and nearby dining and shopping. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Enjoy exceptional outdoor spaces, including a private pool (heating available for an additional fee), hot tub, fire pit, and multiple porches and balconies. Walk to Dune Allen Regional Access for sugar-white sands and emerald waters, or enjoy nearby bike trails along 30A.
